card.name: Linking word before a brand drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, of, including, in, and just before a brand-name drug is named in warnings and precautions, mostly for diabetes drugs (GLP-1 agonists, DPP-4 inhibitors).

modes.label: with + brand
modes.description: The word "with" ends an angioedema statement and a product name follows.
modes.example: a history of angioedema to another DPP-4 inhibitor because it is unknown whether such patients will be predisposed to angioedema<< with>> TRIJARDY XR.

modes.label: including + brand
modes.description: The word "including" follows a drug class and leads into a named product.
modes.example: Has been observed in patients treated with GLP-1 receptor agonists,<< including>> TRULICITY. Discontinue if

modes.label: of / in + brand
modes.description: A preposition after a discontinue or rate statement comes right before the product name.
modes.example: promptly seek medical attention and discontinue use<< of>> FOUNDAYO. FOUNDAYO is
